# Kolaboro

> Kolaboro is a network of local buyer's agents for overseas property. Agents are trained by AI, work only for the buyer, verify land titles, permits and developers, film every construction milestone with GPS-stamped video and tell buyers when each payment is safe. Kolaboro also publishes a 0-100 Trust Score for projects and developers. Launching in Bali.

## Facts
- Prices (Bali, launch): pre-purchase check EUR 490; construction monitoring EUR 99 per month; buyer's agent 1% of price, minimum EUR 2,000.
- Agents are never paid by developers. Paying for verification never changes a Trust Score.
- Kolaboro does not currently hold client money and does not give legal or financial advice.
